description: Chrome 'Copy as cURL (cmd)' of the PUT in chrome-bash-ansi-c-body: %, quotes, backslashes, shell operators, line feeds (^ LF LF) and non-ASCII. Chrome doubles every backslash, but the C runtime only halves backslashes that precede a quote, so curl.exe receives interior backslashes doubled (C:\\temp) while a backslash before the closing quote arrives single. HARborer imports exactly what curl.exe would receive.
